f3_program: collection("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "buyer_count", "grocery_store", source("buyers who've visited the store in the three days"))
member("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.today", source("buyers in the grocery store today"))
member("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.yesterday", source("buyers yesterday"))
member("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.day_before", source("the day before had 50 buyers"))

offset(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.today", "today"), at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.yesterday", "yesterday"), 40, "count", source("There are 40 more buyers in the grocery store today than yesterday"))

fraction_of(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.yesterday", "yesterday"), at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.day_before", "day_before"), 1, 2, source("There were half the number of buyers yesterday as there were the day before"))
observe(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts.day_before", "day_before"), 50, "count", source("the day before had 50 buyers"))
partition("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", at("grocery_store.buyers.count", "three_days"), source("Nobody visited the store on more than one day"))
query("value", at("grocery_store.buyers.count", "three_days"))

collection("angeli.candies", "candy", "angeli", source("Angeli had 90 assorted candies"))
observe(at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), 90, "count", source("Angeli had 90 assorted candies"))
member("angeli.candies", "angeli.candies.lollipops", source("One-third of the candies were lollipops"))
member("angeli.candies", "angeli.candies.candy_canes", source("the rest were candy canes"))
fraction_of(at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), 1, 3, source("One-third of the candies were lollipops"))
difference_relation(at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), source("the rest were candy canes"))
collection("angeli.candy_recipient_counts", "recipient_count", "angeli.candy_sharing", source("the boys such that each boy received 3. She then shared the candy canes equally among the girls"))
member("angeli.candy_recipient_counts", "angeli.candy_recipient_counts.boys", source("the boys"))
member("angeli.candy_recipient_counts", "angeli.candy_recipient_counts.girls", source("the girls"))

transfer("share_lollipops", "angeli", at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "current"), at("angeli.candy_sharing.boys.lollipops.count", "current"), at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), source("She then shared the lollipops equally among the boys"))
observe(at("angeli.candy_sharing.boys.lollipops_per_person.count", "after_sharing"), 3, "count", source("each boy received 3"))

product_relation(at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candy_recipient_counts.boys", "after_sharing"), at("angeli.candy_sharing.boys.lollipops_per_person.count", "after_sharing"), source("shared the lollipops equally among the boys such that each boy received 3"))

transfer("share_candy_canes", "angeli", at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "current"), at("angeli.candy_sharing.girls.candy_canes.count", "current"), at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "initial"), source("She then shared the candy canes equally among the girls"))
observe(at("angeli.candy_sharing.girls.candy_canes_per_person.count", "after_sharing"), 2, "count", source("each received 2"))

product_relation(at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candy_recipient_counts.girls", "after_sharing"), at("angeli.candy_sharing.girls.candy_canes_per_person.count", "after_sharing"), source("shared the candy canes equally among the girls such that each received 2"))
query("sum", "angeli.candy_recipient_counts", "after_sharing")
